newsitem.title: USA: Essential Resources results filing delayed.
newsitem.headline: Essential Resources results filing delayed.

text.p: Essential Resources Inc said Tuesday there will be a brief delay in reporting the change of its year-end results.
Essential Resources Chief Executive Phillip Cook said the company expects to report the results "in the next day or so."
The delay was attributed to a change in its auditors to BDO Seidman LLP from Smith & Co. The company also has changed the end of its fiscal year to June 30 instead of December 31.
The delay will not affect the payment of a dividend of $0.05 per share on October 30 to shareholders of record on September 30.
Essential Resources develops, markets and distributes health, beauty-aid, vitamin and nutritional supplement products.
